title: Sparkly rainbow
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Rainbow arcs -->
  <path d="M15 85 A35 35 0 0 1 85 85" fill="none" stroke="#ff4444" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M22 85 A28 28 0 0 1 78 85" fill="none" stroke="#ff8800" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M29 85 A21 21 0 0 1 71 85" fill="none" stroke="#ffee00" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M35 85 A15 15 0 0 1 65 85" fill="none" stroke="#44dd44" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M41 85 A9 9 0 0 1 59 85" fill="none" stroke="#44aaff" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M47 85 A3 3 0 0 1 53 85" fill="none" stroke="#aa66ff" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- Sparkles -->
  <!-- Large sparkle top left -->
  <g transform="translate(18,20)">
    <polygon points="0,-7 2,-2 7,0 2,2 0,7 -2,2 -7,0 -2,-2" fill="#ffe066"/>
  </g>
  <!-- Large sparkle top right -->
  <g transform="translate(82,18)">
    <polygon points="0,-6 1.5,-1.5 6,0 1.5,1.5 0,6 -1.5,1.5 -6,0 -1.5,-1.5" fill="#fff4aa"/>
  </g>
  <!-- Medium sparkle left mid -->
  <g transform="translate(10,55)">
    <polygon points="0,-5 1.5,-1.5 5,0 1.5,1.5 0,5 -1.5,1.5 -5,0 -1.5,-1.5" fill="#ffffff"/>
  </g>
  <!-- Medium sparkle right mid -->
  <g transform="translate(90,52)">
    <polygon points="0,-5 1.5,-1.5 5,0 1.5,1.5 0,5 -1.5,1.5 -5,0 -1.5,-1.5" fill="#ffe066"/>
  </g>
  <!-- Small sparkles -->
  <g transform="translate(50,12)">
    <polygon points="0,-4 1,-1 4,0 1,1 0,4 -1,1 -4,0 -1,-1" fill="#fff4aa"/>
  </g>
  <g transform="translate(30,40)">
    <polygon points="0,-3 0.8,-0.8 3,0 0.8,0.8 0,3 -0.8,0.8 -3,0 -0.8,-0.8" fill="#ffffff"/>
  </g>
  <g transform="translate(72,38)">
    <polygon points="0,-3 0.8,-0.8 3,0 0.8,0.8 0,3 -0.8,0.8 -3,0 -0.8,-0.8" fill="#ffffff"/>
  </g>
  <g transform="translate(8,35)">
    <polygon points="0,-3.5 0.8,-0.8 3.5,0 0.8,0.8 0,3.5 -0.8,0.8 -3.5,0 -0.8,-0.8" fill="#ffe066"/>
  </g>
  <g transform="translate(92,32)">
    <polygon points="0,-3.5 0.8,-0.8 3.5,0 0.8,0.8 0,3.5 -0.8,0.8 -3.5,0 -0.8,-0.8" fill="#fff4aa"/>
  </g>
  <g transform="translate(45,6)">
    <polygon points="0,-3 0.8,-0.8 3,0 0.8,0.8 0,3 -0.8,0.8 -3,0 -0.8,-0.8" fill="#ffffff"/>
  </g>
  <g transform="translate(60,8)">
    <polygon points="0,-2.5 0.7,-0.7 2.5,0 0.7,0.7 0,2.5 -0.7,0.7 -2.5,0 -0.7,-0.7" fill="#ffe066"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Small dots/sparkles near ends -->
  <circle cx="15" cy="88" r="1.5" fill="#ff4444"/>
  <circle cx="85" cy="88" r="1.5" fill="#aa66ff"/>
  <circle cx="12" cy="78" r="1.2" fill="#ffe066"/>
  <circle cx="88" cy="76" r="1.2" fill="#fff4aa"/>
</svg>
